channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Tokio Marine unit plans to boost hedged foreign currency bonds
item.description: Tokio Marine & Nichido Anshin Life Insurance seeks returns outside the domestic market even as some peers move money back into Japan.

item.title: Couples pick Japan’s World Heritage sites to tie the knot
item.description: Local governments are welcoming the trend, as they hope to balance the preservation and utilization of cultural properties.

item.title: Why is Sheikh Hasina’s plan to return to Bangladesh contentious?
item.description: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return home on Dec. 16 from self-imposed exile in India.

item.title: Japan to amend law regarding the investigation of self-driving car accidents
item.description: The move comes as the country's first driverless taxi services are planned to be launched in 2027.

item.title: India pledges $1.6bn to Nepal in reset of ties
item.description: As Nepal rebuilds after deadly floods, its prime minister sets contentious issues aside to secure Indian funding, port access and a new train service.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
